title: Shift Swap Approval Form
subtitle: Use this approval to test evidence and authority, resolve conflicts, issue a bounded decision, and verify every resulting update for a shift swap workflow.
description: An original operational shift swap approval form that controls a paired schedule-change and coverage record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the requesting workers, scheduler, or shift manager needs a traceable approval so the authorized scheduling, payroll, operations, or HR reviewer can approve, conditionally approve, deny, cancel, reverse, or correct the proposed shift exchange under the current schedule, role-qualification matrix, rest and overtime rules, labor agreement, and applicable scheduling policy without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Shift Swap approval submission and authority route
sections.guidance: Identify the proposed action, submitter, decision authority, effective point, and required evidence.

blocks.label: Shift Swap identity
Approval ownership and routing
Approval control
Proposed action, purpose, exact scope, affected people or work, exclusions, and requested conditions

sections.title: Shift Swap evidence completeness and readiness
sections.guidance: Reject unsupported assumptions before the decision reaches an approver.

blocks.label: Shift Swap approval readiness
items: Both original and proposed shift segments reconcile
Coverage, skill mix, qualification, and supervision remain sufficient
Both workers consented without coercion or undisclosed exchange
Rest, overtime, premium, and agreement rules were reviewed
Conflicts with leave, training, restrictions, or assignments are resolved
Manager and scheduler have authority for the affected locations
System updates and worker notifications have named owners
Conditional approval includes a deadline and automatic fallback

blocks.label: Evidence package submitted
items: Published original schedule and schedule-period reference
Worker identity, role, qualification, and access records
Paired worker acknowledgments with date and time
Coverage and skill-mix review
Rest, overtime, premium, or agreement-rule check
Manager, scheduler, or second-level decision
Updated scheduling and timekeeping system reference
Cancellation, no-show, correction, or payroll follow-up record

blocks.label: Required item, evidence, owner, status, and deficiency

sections.title: Shift Swap policy, authority, and impact review
sections.guidance: Apply the current decision standard and record each reviewer within their actual authority.

blocks.label: Shift Swap policy and impact checks
items: Original schedule segments exist and belong to the stated workers
Proposed worker is qualified for the location, role, task, and equipment
Required coverage, skill mix, supervision, and headcount remain intact
Rest, consecutive-day, fatigue, and scheduling limits were checked
Overtime, premium, differential, and labor-cost effects are known
Applicable notice, seniority, bidding, or agreement terms were reviewed
Both workers' consent is current, voluntary, and independently recorded
Conflicts with leave, training, restrictions, or other assignments are resolved
Scheduling and timekeeping systems can reflect the same approved segments
Cancellation and failed-handoff responsibilities are explicit

blocks.label: Review area, reviewer, authority, evidence, finding, and condition
People, schedule, service, cost, payroll, privacy, security, safety, consistency, and system impacts

sections.title: Shift Swap conflicts, exceptions, and approval conditions
sections.guidance: Resolve material conflicts and convert every condition into owned, verifiable work.

blocks.label: Approval stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the authorized scheduling, payroll, operations, or HR reviewer under the current schedule, role-qualification matrix, rest and overtime rules, labor agreement, and applicable scheduling policy.

blocks.label: Shift Swap exception and escalation triggers
items: Approved change was not entered or appeared differently in a system
Worker reported to the wrong time, role, unit, or location
No-show or uncovered interval followed the exchange
Worker lacked required qualification, access, or supervision
Rest, fatigue, overtime, premium, or agreement constraint was missed
Worker reports coercion, retaliation, side payment, or false consent
Cancellation or reversal was not communicated to every affected party
Timekeeping or payroll result does not match the approved schedule

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale
Approval condition, prerequisite, owner, due point, evidence, and expiry

sections.title: Shift Swap approval decision and effective boundary
sections.guidance: Record one unambiguous decision with rationale, authority, conditions, and review date.

blocks.label: Approval boundary
blocks.guidance: Approval is valid only within the stated scope and authority. The authorized scheduling, payroll, operations, or HR reviewer must apply the current schedule, role-qualification matrix, rest and overtime rules, labor agreement, and applicable scheduling policy; a signature does not override a required privacy, safety, security, legal, payroll, tax, or accommodation review.

blocks.label: Approval decision
Evidence relied upon, contrary evidence, alternatives, conditions, limits, and reason for decision
Submission, qualified review, and decision authorization

fields.label: Authorized Scheduling, Payroll, Operations, Or Hr Reviewer / date

sections.title: Shift Swap implementation, notification, and approval closeout
sections.guidance: Verify that the approved outcome reached every affected system and recipient.

blocks.label: Approved implementation, system update, notification, and verification
Approval outcome and handoff
Open shift swap action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Approval accountable review
